title: Origin story: Brackenmore
description: Brackenmore was a forester who spent forty years in the understory, learning the fern-law: grow where you are, hold the soil, outlast the canopy. When the great fire came, the ferns he had tended held the soil and the forest returned in a single season. The forest named him king, and he accepted with fern-like humility.

description: Powers: Ferns grow at his word; The understory hides him perfectly; He outlasts — that is his power.
